shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat upright slab
registers or vertical bands organizing the surface
repeated small motifs in a row/band
limbs with detailed digits/claws rendered as parallel strokes
justification: Both are low-relief upright slabs with profile creatures and a band of repeated small motifs, but that is about as generic as shared iconography gets. A shows stacked registers of purely animal forms (a fox-like beast, birds, a crane-like bird, insect/scorpion-like shapes) with no human presence, while B shows a single large winged anthropomorphic figure holding objects, framed by floral/rosette borders — different subject, different composition, and a far more naturalistic, musculature-and-drapery style versus A's flat schematic silhouettes.
